title: SMBs often fail [3.1.0.3] [DASH]
symptom: After an initial SMB has been successfully given, subsequent SMBs often fail for a few loop cycles, resulting in high BG. This started after upgrading from 3.0.3 to 3.1.0.3. There is no notification in AAPS or system when SMBs fail.
cause: The SMB command is canceled because both basal and SMB are present in the result, and the SMB command has a timeout of one minute from the original calculation, but the basal command consumes that time. The SMB is canceled due to the timeout check in CommandSMBBolus.kt.
fix: The fix was implemented by MilosKozak in commit baab2dad4c50ff9e3ab7d93660f2204d3c2ffcf5. The fix was confirmed by rustymonkey after testing for 36 hours on Boost_Test_Platform, all SMBs were delivered successfully.
